notes: What a burst or a hit does to an aircraft (simcore/damage.hpp): none, light (largely unaffected), moderate (smoke, jettison, abort), heavy (smoke, fire, a crash 10 s to 5 min later) or destroyed. A burst's fragments strike it Poisson(N A / (4 pi d^2) exp(-d / R)) times; a contact round strikes it once. Each strike is critical, serious or light; three lights make a moderate, two moderates make heavy (the project owner's rule, 2 Nov 2026). Calibrated in docs/DAMAGE.md against docs/research/AAA_DAMAGE_2026-11.md.
source: game values (sam3d), set against docs/research/AAA_DAMAGE_2026-11.md where it gives a figure; the adding-up and the crash window are the project owner's rule of 2 Nov 2026

fragments_per_kg.source: estimate: lethal fragments per kg of casing, set so a 130 mm shell bursting 15 m off strikes a fighter about ten times (docs/DAMAGE.md)

fragment_reach_m.source: estimate: the fragments' reach per cube root of the charge's kg (40 m for the KS-30's 3.5 kg), so bursts 30-50 m off mostly do nothing (the project owner, 2 Nov 2026)

fragment_critical.source: game value: a fragment's strike on an engine, fuel, the controls or the crew

fragment_serious.source: game value: a strike that leaves the aircraft moderately damaged

blast_destroy_m.source: estimate: the blast destroys outright inside 2 m per cube root of the charge's kg (3 m for 3.5 kg)

blast_heavy_m.source: estimate: heavily damaged inside 3.5 m per cube root of the charge's kg

area_per_size2.source: estimate: a fighter of 10 m presents about 20 m2 to a burst (a convex body's mean projection is a quarter of its surface)

lights_per_moderate.source: game value: the project owner's rule (docs/DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md track R, 2 Nov 2026): three light damage instances make moderate

moderates_per_heavy.source: game value: the project owner's rule (docs/DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md track R, 2 Nov 2026): two moderate damage instances make heavy

critical_destroys.source: game value: a critical strike that destroys the aircraft outright, else heavily damaged

heavy_crash.source: game value: a heavily damaged aircraft that does not get home

crash_min_s.source: game value: the project owner's rule (docs/DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md track R, 2 Nov 2026): 10 s to 5 min before it crashes

crash_max_s.source: game value: the project owner's rule (docs/DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md track R, 2 Nov 2026); affdl_tr_77_115 has 32-50% of fatal gun hits down inside about 40 s, the rest up to 6 min and more

heavy_fire.source: affdl_tr_77_115: fire or explosion in 44.2% of the F-105's losses to ground fire

heavy_jettison.source: estimate: a damaged aircraft jettisons its stores 80% of the time (docs/research/AAA_DAMAGE_2026-11.md section 7, anchored on checo_1969_tactics)

moderate_smoke.source: estimate: moderate damage trails smoke about 30% of the time (docs/research/AAA_DAMAGE_2026-11.md section 7)

moderate_jettison.source: estimate: a damaged aircraft jettisons its stores 80% of the time (docs/research/AAA_DAMAGE_2026-11.md section 7, anchored on checo_1969_tactics)

missile_heavy_share.source: game value: a missile's kill that leaves the aircraft flying for a while before it falls

missile_near_burst.source: game value: a missile that missed bursting near enough to strike

missile_fragments_per_kg.source: estimate: a fragmentation warhead's lethal fragments per kg of its charge

moderate_g_factor.source: game value (roadmap S4): a moderately damaged aircraft is flown more gently, its g limit 80% of its type's (docs/DAMAGE.md section on what damage leaves)

heavy_g_factor.source: game value (roadmap S4): a heavily damaged aircraft is nursed home, half its type's g limit

moderate_thrust_factor.source: game value (roadmap S4): moderate damage costs a tenth of the engine's thrust and the drag of holes and lost panels

heavy_thrust_factor.source: game value (roadmap S4): heavy damage (an engine hit, a fire) costs about 40% of the thrust

moderate_fuel_leak.source: game value (roadmap S4): a moderate hit that holes the fuel system

heavy_fuel_leak.source: game value (roadmap S4): a heavy hit that holes the fuel system

fuel_leak_min_s.source: game value (roadmap S4): a holed aircraft's fuel left, 5 to 20 minutes, about the A and B kills of affdl_tr_77_115 (down 5-50 and over 50 nm after the hit)

escort_share.source: game value (roadmap S4): a wingman sent home with a damaged aircraft half the time (a buddy escort was the practice where the flight could spare one: docs/DAMAGE.md)

critical.source: estimate: one 23 mm hit destroys 0.10 and heavily damages 0.15 (docs/research/AAA_DAMAGE_2026-11.md section 7, calibrated on affdl_tr_77_115 and werrell_2005)
estimate: one 37 mm hit destroys 0.20 and heavily damages 0.20 (docs/research/AAA_DAMAGE_2026-11.md section 7)
estimate: one 57 mm hit destroys 0.30 and heavily damages 0.25 (docs/research/AAA_DAMAGE_2026-11.md section 7)
